headline: 'Chicken eggs' price up 4 baht per egg, highest in 2 years, effective today (7 Aug 69)
summary: Four egg-layer cooperatives raised the mixed egg farm-gate price to 4 baht per egg, lifting retail prices by 6 baht per tray. It is the highest level in two years, effective 7 August.
why: Food prices feed into consumer inflation, which affects household spending and central bank policy.
